text.content: People make friends through repeated, unplanned interactions. A weekly recurring event provides a great default for this. After coming a few times, you start to remember the folks who you’ve met, what matters in their lives, how they are doing.

text.content: Cooking together is great for bonding — you have to solve the nontrivial logistics problem of preparing food for 30 people, as quickly as possible. text.content: Oral history

rich_text.plain_text: Oral history

text.content: Taco Tuesday started 3 years ago, during the pandemic. My friends Karthik, Michael, and Dan were getting bored of shelter-in-place and illicitly invited me over for tacos. Breaking quarantine was so joyful, and I wanted to keep doing it — we settled into a pattern of seeing each other and making great tacos. So for a long time it was just 3-4 friends getting together, bringing ingredients, cooking together, catching up, watching anime.
